values./system/biography: A legendary Protectron gunfighter guarding Dry Rock Gulch.
values./items/@21188c399a016573/system/descript: Body + Guns (TN 12), Burst, Piercing 1, Range C, Fire Rate 4.
values./items/@52b22de1cf255ca7/system/descript: This character is a robot: it cannot use consumables or heal naturally, and damage must be repaired. It is immune to hunger, thirst and suffocation.
values./items/@106348db51a91029/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@ac323e6db0ea9d25/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@be4c8d69fc56f0fe/system/descript: Ike always acts last and Arm Lasers target the visible enemy with the lowest Initiative, adding Fire Rate to damage.
values./items/@5be76f16c2926392/system/descript: Each injured arm reduces Arm Lasers Fire Rate by 2.
